flow_ref: User story (not in a flow deck, OCMS has none)
code_summary: ocmsadminui NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts (getNoticesByCourtBatchNo, not called by a page), Notice/form/History.tsx (grid + commented-out tab); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (3 columns); ocmsadminprivateapi sftp-prod.properties. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court application code
note: The story asks the officer to browse the batch number to see the status of each notice and whether the batch is fully processed. There is no court batch page/menu. Function getNoticesByCourtBatchNo exists in the hook but no page calls it, and it calls /v1/courtcase, which has no controller in ocmsadminapi; the Court Application History grid (batch_status) exists but its tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172); the backend stores neither batches nor per-notice outcomes. No maintenance ticket is specific to this feature. The SFTP demo remark and the 'Demo paid' status: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Ask URA/the team in which repo the court batch browse is built, or mark it as a gap. The UI pieces (hook and grid) could be reused once a courtcase backend exists.

steps.step: Officer opens a browse page for the court application batch number in the staff portal
steps.detail: Function getNoticesByCourtBatchNo(csd_batch_no) exists in the hook (useSearch.ts:144-158) and is exported (useSearch.ts:180-181), but no page calls it (grep getNoticesByCourtBatchNo only hits useSearch.ts) and there is no court batch route/menu. It also calls /v1/courtcase, which has no controller in ocmsadminapi.

steps.step: OCMS shows the status of each notice in that batch
steps.detail: A Court Application History grid with batch_status, Outcome Date, Court Outcome Status columns exists at History.tsx:71-100, but its tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172), and the backend has no batch_status or court_reject column/table (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31). There is no per-batch view.

steps.step: Officer can see whether State Courts has fully processed the batch or some notices are still pending an outcome
steps.detail: No complete/pending batch calculation or indicator exists: no return file comes in (sftp-prod.properties:57-107 has no State Courts) and there is no per-notice outcome column to count (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31).
